text.name: Hoppip

attacks.name: Flail Around
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

text.name: Skiploom

attacks.name: Bullet Seed
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.

text.name: Jumpluff

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Leave It to the Wind
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may return this Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your hand.

attacks.name: Acrobatics
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

text.flavor: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.

text.name: Yanma

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

text.flavor: It can hover in one spot by flapping its wings at high speed. It flits about to guard its territory.

text.name: Yanmega

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

text.flavor: Its jaw power is incredible. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.

text.name: Wurmple

attacks.name: Sleep Poison
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned.

text.flavor: Often targeted by bird Pokémon, it desperately resists by releasing poison from its tail spikes.

text.name: Silcoon

attacks.name: Harden
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon would be damaged by an attack, prevent that attack's damage done to this Pokémon if that damage is 60 or less.

text.flavor: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.

text.name: Beautifly

attacks.name: Triple Energy
attacks.text: Search your deck for 3 different types of basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Drainpour
attacks.text: Heal 40 damage from each of your Benched Pokémon.

text.flavor: Despite its looks, it is aggressive. It jabs with its long, thin mouth if disturbed while collecting pollen.

text.name: Cascoon

attacks.name: Tangle Drag
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Spiral Drain
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

text.name: Nincada

attacks.name: Dig
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

text.flavor: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.

text.name: Ninjask

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Cast-off Shell
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may search your deck for Shedinja and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Night Slash
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

text.flavor: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.

text.name: Roselia

attacks.name: Double Whip
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Relaxing Fragrance
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage and remove all Special Conditions from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: The more healthy the Roselia, the more pleasant its flowers' aroma. Its scent deeply relaxes people.

text.name: Roselia

attacks.name: Needling Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

text.flavor: The more healthy the Roselia, the more pleasant its flowers' aroma. Its scent deeply relaxes people.

text.name: Roserade

attacks.name: Crosswise Whip
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Poison Point
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

text.flavor: Each of its hands contains different toxins, but both hands can jab with near-fatal power.

text.name: Roserade

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Le Parfum
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may search your deck for any card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Squeeze
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: Each of its hands contains different toxins, but both hands can jab with near-fatal power.

text.name: Maractus

attacks.name: Stun Needle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Reinforced Needle
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, this attack does 40 more damage.

text.flavor: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.

text.name: Foongus

attacks.name: Double Spin
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: For some reason, this Pokémon resembles a Poké Ball. They release poison spores to repel those who try to catch them.

text.name: Vulpix

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

text.flavor: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.

text.name: Ninetales

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Bright Look
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with his or her Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hexed Flame
attacks.text: Does 50 more damage for each Special Condition affecting the Defending Pokémon.

text.flavor: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.

text.name: Magmar
text.flavor: When it breathes deeply, heat waves form around its body, making it hard to see clearly.

text.name: Magmortar

attacks.name: Flame Screen
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

text.flavor: When launching 3,600 degrees F fireballs, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Rebirth
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is in your discard pile, you may flip a coin. If heads, put this Pokémon onto your Bench and attach 3 different types of basic Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Rainbow Burn
attacks.text: Does 20 more damage for each different type of basic Energy attached to this Pokémon.

rules.label: Pokémon-EX rule
rules.text: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Magikarp

attacks.name: Soggy Rush
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: A Magikarp living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.

text.name: Gyarados

attacks.name: Swing Around
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

text.flavor: Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.

text.name: Wailmer

attacks.name: Lullaby
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

text.flavor: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.

text.name: Wailord

attacks.name: Water Cannon
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage times the amount of {Water} Energy attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Giant Wave
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Giant Wave during your next turn.

text.flavor: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.

text.name: Feebas

attacks.name: Add-a-Dash
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, draw a card.

text.flavor: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

text.name: Milotic

attacks.name: Clear Search
attacks.text: Search your deck for any 3 cards and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Water Pulse
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

text.flavor: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.

text.name: Spheal

attacks.name: Unstoppable Roll
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

text.flavor: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.

text.name: Sealeo
text.flavor: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.

text.name: Walrein

attacks.name: Ice Entomb
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. This Pokémon can't use Ice Entomb during your next turn.

text.flavor: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.

text.name: Buizel
text.flavor: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

text.name: Floatzel
text.flavor: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and carry off prey.

text.name: Tympole

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

text.name: Palpitoad

attacks.name: Supersonic
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

text.flavor: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

text.name: Seismitoad

attacks.name: Echoed Voice
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Echoed Voice attack does 50 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Drain Punch
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

text.name: Alomomola

attacks.name: Mysterious Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.

text.name: Mareep

attacks.name: Cotton Guard
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Thunder Jolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

text.flavor: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

text.name: Flaaffy

attacks.name: Cotton Guard
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

text.flavor: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

text.name: Ampharos

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Electromagnetic Wall
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, whenever your opponent attaches an Energy from his or her hand to 1 of his or her Pokémon, put 3 damage counters on that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Electrobullet
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail's light.

text.name: Electrike

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

text.flavor: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

text.name: Electrike

attacks.name: Quick Turn
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

text.name: Manectric

attacks.name: Energy Crush
attacks.text: Does 20 damage times the amount of Energy attached to all of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Flash Impact
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

text.name: Manectric

attacks.name: Energy Assist
attacks.text: Attach 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

text.flavor: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

text.name: Emolga

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

text.flavor: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Versatile
abilities.text: This Pokémon can use the attacks of any Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's). (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)

attacks.name: Replace
attacks.text: Move as many Energy attached to your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like.

rules.label: Pokémon-EX rule
rules.text: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Dustox

attacks.name: Hazardous Scales
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep, Burned, and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Aerial Ace
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

text.flavor: Toxic powder is scattered with each flap. At night, it is known to strip leaves off trees lining boulevards.

text.name: Shedinja

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Empty Shell
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out, your opponent can't take any Prize cards for it.

attacks.name: Cursed Drop
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

text.flavor: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one's spirit.

text.name: Drifloon

attacks.name: Sneaky Placement
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

text.flavor: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a "Signpost for Wandering Spirits."

text.name: Drifloon
text.flavor: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a "Signpost for Wandering Spirits."

text.name: Drifblim

attacks.name: Shadow Steal
attacks.text: Does 50 damage times the number of Special Energy cards in your opponent's discard pile.

attacks.name: Plentiful Placement
attacks.text: Put 4 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

text.flavor: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.

text.name: Sigilyph

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Safeguard
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon by Pokémon-EX.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: Does 10 more damage for each Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

text.flavor: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.

text.name: Trubbish

attacks.name: Poison Gas
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

text.flavor: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

text.name: Garbodor

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Garbotoxin
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, each Pokémon in play, in each player's hand, and in each player's discard pile has no Abilities (except for Garbotoxin).

text.flavor: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.

text.name: Gothita

attacks.name: Future Sight
attacks.text: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck and put them back on top of your deck in any order.

text.flavor: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.

text.name: Gothorita

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Mind Shock
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

text.flavor: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

text.name: Gothitelle

attacks.name: Doom Decree
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, the Defending Pokémon is Knocked Out.

attacks.name: Black Magic
attacks.text: Does 20 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

text.flavor: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

text.name: Golett

attacks.name: Nap
attacks.text: Heal 40 damage from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

text.name: Golurk

attacks.name: Devolution Punch
attacks.text: Devolve the Defending Pokémon and put the highest Stage Evolution card on it into your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Ghost Hammer
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon has no Weakness.

text.flavor: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

text.name: Cubone
text.flavor: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.

text.name: Marowak

attacks.name: Bone Lock
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Vortex Chop
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has any Resistance, this attack does 30 more damage.

text.flavor: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.

text.name: Nosepass
text.flavor: When endangered, it may protect itself by raising its magnetism and drawing iron objects to its body.

text.name: Baltoy

attacks.name: Reverse Spin
attacks.text: Your opponent shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck and draws 4 cards.

text.flavor: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

text.name: Claydol

attacks.name: Rapid Spin
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. Then, your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Rock Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

text.flavor: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.

text.name: Roggenrola

attacks.name: Stone Edge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

text.flavor: They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an energy core.

text.name: Boldore

attacks.name: Rock Cannon
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.

text.name: Gigalith

attacks.name: Revenge Cannon
attacks.text: Does 10 more damage for each damage counter on each of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 40 damage to itself.

text.flavor: The solar energy absorbed by its body's orange crystals is magnified internally and fired from its mouth.

text.name: Throh

attacks.name: Squeeze
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Superpower
attacks.text: You may do 20 more damage. If you do, this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

text.flavor: When they encounter foes bigger than themselves, they try to throw them. They always travel in packs of five.

text.name: Sawk

attacks.name: Defensive Stance
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon. Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Karate Chop
attacks.text: Does 70 damage minus 10 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

text.flavor: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.

text.name: Stunfisk

attacks.name: Muddy Water
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Rumble
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

text.flavor: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.

attacks.name: Rock Tumble
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

attacks.name: Pump-up Smash
attacks.text: Attach 2 basic Energy cards from your hand to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

rules.label: Pokémon-EX rule
rules.text: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Murkrow
text.flavor: If spotted, it will lure an unwary person into chasing it, then lose the pursuer on mountain trails.

text.name: Honchkrow

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: You may have your opponent switch the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Diving Swipe
attacks.text: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

text.flavor: If one utters a deep cry, many Murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called "Summoner of Night."

text.name: Houndour
text.flavor: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.

text.name: Houndoom

attacks.name: Fire Fang
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

text.flavor: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.

text.name: Stunky

attacks.name: Acid Spray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

text.flavor: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.

text.name: Skuntank

attacks.name: Smogscreen
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

text.flavor: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. Attacks from above confound it.

text.name: Aron

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

text.flavor: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

text.name: Lairon

attacks.name: Wreak Havoc
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

text.flavor: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes its steely body against others to fight over territory.

text.name: Aggron

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Toppling Wind
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may discard the top 3 cards of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Giga Horn
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are tails, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

attacks.name: Triple Laser
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 3 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Protect Charge
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

rules.label: Pokémon-EX rule
rules.text: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Probopass

attacks.name: Magnetic Lines
attacks.text: You may move an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Heavy Nose
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 30 more damage.

text.flavor: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

text.name: Durant

attacks.name: Pull Out
attacks.text: Put a card from your discard pile on top of your deck.

attacks.name: Iron Head
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: Durant dig nests in mountains. They build their complicated, interconnected tunnels into mazes.

text.name: Altaria

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Fight Song
abilities.text: Your {Dragon} Pokémon's attacks do 20 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

text.flavor: If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop the friend with its soft wings, then hum.

attacks.name: Celestial Roar
attacks.text: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck. If any of those cards are Energy cards, attach them to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dragon Burst
attacks.text: Discard all basic {Fire} Energy or all basic {Lightning} Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 60 damage times the number of Energy cards you discarded.

rules.label: Pokémon-EX rule
rules.text: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Gible
text.flavor: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.

text.name: Gible

attacks.name: Sand-Attack
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Knock Away
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

text.flavor: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.

text.name: Gabite

attacks.name: Shred
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on the Defending Pokémon.

text.flavor: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.

text.name: Gabite

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Dragon Call
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for a {Dragon} Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

text.flavor: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.

text.name: Garchomp

attacks.name: Mach Cut
attacks.text: Discard a Special Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dragonblade
attacks.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck.

text.flavor: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.

text.name: Garchomp

attacks.name: Sand Tomb
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

text.flavor: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.

attacks.name: Shred
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dragon Pulse
attacks.text: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck.

rules.label: Pokémon-EX rule
rules.text: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Deino

attacks.name: Deep Growl
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Power Breath
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

text.flavor: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

text.name: Deino

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

text.flavor: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.

text.name: Zweilous

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

text.flavor: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

text.name: Zweilous

attacks.name: Draw In
attacks.text: Attach 2 {Darkness} Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

text.flavor: Since their two heads do not get along and compete with each other for food, they always eat too much.

text.name: Hydreigon

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Dark Trance
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move a {Darkness} Energy attached to 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dragonblast
attacks.text: Discard 2 {Darkness} Energy attached to this Pokémon.

text.flavor: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.

text.name: Hydreigon

attacks.name: Consume
attacks.text: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Destructor Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

text.flavor: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

text.name: Aipom

attacks.name: Double Hit
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: It lives high among the treetops. It can use its tail as freely and cleverly as its hands.

text.name: Ambipom

attacks.name: Double Hit
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Hand Fling
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of cards in your hand.

text.flavor: Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things, Ambipom rarely uses its hands.

text.name: Slakoth

attacks.name: Smack 'n' Slack
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Asleep.

text.flavor: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.

text.name: Vigoroth

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage.

text.flavor: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still for even a moment.

text.name: Slaking

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Unobservant
abilities.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, this Pokémon can't attack.

attacks.name: Crushing Blow
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

text.flavor: The world's laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.

text.name: Swablu

attacks.name: Sing
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

text.flavor: It can't relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.

text.name: Swablu
text.flavor: It can't relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.

text.name: Bidoof

attacks.name: Bang Heads
attacks.text: Both this Pokémon and the Defending Pokémon are now Confused.

text.flavor: A comparison revealed that Bidoof's front teeth grow at the same rate as Rattata's.

text.name: Bibarel

attacks.name: Amnesia
attacks.text: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Tumbling Tackle
attacks.text: Both this Pokémon and the Defending Pokémon are now Asleep.

text.flavor: A river dammed by Bibarel will never overflow its banks, which is appreciated by people nearby.

text.name: Audino

attacks.name: Wake-up Beam
attacks.text: Remove all Special Conditions from the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Drain Slap
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: Its auditory sense is astounding. It has a radarlike ability to understand its surroundings through slight sounds.

text.name: Minccino

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

text.flavor: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

text.name: Bouffalant

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Bouffer
abilities.text: Any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Gold Breaker
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is a Pokémon-EX, this attack does 60 more damage.

text.flavor: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.

text.name: Rufflet

attacks.name: Chirp
attacks.text: Search your deck for 2 Pokémon with {Fighting} Resistance, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Sharp Beak
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

text.flavor: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.

text.name: Braviary

attacks.name: Fury Attack
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

text.name: Devolution Spray
effect: Devolve 1 of your evolved Pokémon and put the highest stage Evolution card on it into your hand. (That Pokémon can't evolve this turn.)

rules.text: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

effect: The Pokémon this card is attached to gets +20 HP.

effect: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out by damage from an attack, put that Pokémon into your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that Pokémon.)

rules.text: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Tool Scrapper
effect: Choose up to 2 Pokémon Tool cards attached to Pokémon in play (yours or your opponent's) and discard them.

text.name: Blend Energy {Grass}{Fire}{Psychic}{Darkness}
effect: This card provides {Colorless} Energy. When this card is attached to a Pokémon, this card provides {Grass}, {Fire}, {Psychic}, or {Darkness} Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time.

text.name: Blend Energy {Water}{Lightning}{Fighting}{Metal}
effect: This card provides {Colorless} Energy. When this card is attached to a Pokémon, this card provides {Water}, {Lightning}, {Fighting}, or {Metal} Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Rebirth
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is in your discard pile, you may flip a coin. If heads, put this Pokémon onto your Bench and attach 3 different types of basic Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Rainbow Burn
attacks.text: Does 20 more damage for each different type of basic Energy attached to this Pokémon.

rules.text: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.text: This Pokémon can use the attacks of any Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's). (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)

attacks.text: Move as many Energy attached to your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

attacks.text: Attach 2 basic Energy cards from your hand to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

rules.label: Pokémon-EX rule
rules.text: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Triple Laser
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 3 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Protect Charge
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

rules.label: Pokémon-EX rule
rules.text: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Celestial Roar
attacks.text: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck. If any of those cards are Energy cards, attach them to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dragon Burst
attacks.text: Discard all basic {Fire} Energy or all basic {Lightning} Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 60 damage times the number of Energy cards you discarded.

rules.label: Pokémon-EX rule
rules.text: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Shred
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dragon Pulse
attacks.text: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck.

rules.text: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Serperior

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Royal Heal
abilities.text: At any time between turns, heal 10 damage from each of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Leaf Tornado
attacks.text: Move as many {Grass} Energy attached to your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like.

text.flavor: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

text.name: Reuniclus

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Damage Swap
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psywave
attacks.text: Does 10 more damage for each Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

text.flavor: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

text.name: Krookodile

attacks.name: Dark Clamp
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Bombast
attacks.text: Does 40 damage times the number of Prize cards you have taken.

text.flavor: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

attacks.name: Dragon Pulse
attacks.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck.

attacks.name: Shred
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on the Defending Pokémon.
